claims.text: Simvastatin and lovastatin ⍉w ritonavir- or cobicistat-boosted ARVs.
claims.quote: Simvastatin and lovastatin are contraindicated with ritonavir- and cobicistat-boosted ARVs

claims.text: REPRIEVE (pts age 40-75 on ART): pitavastatin 4 mg daily ↓MACE 35%.
claims.quote: among people with HIV who were aged 40 to 75 years and were receiving ART, showed that when compared to placebo, pitavastatin 4 mg daily was associated with a 35% reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE)
